relationships.subject: extracorporeal shockwave myocardial revascularization
relationships.evidence_quote: endothelial progenitor cells and angiopoietin-3 were significantly increased whereas IL-18 and TGF-β were significantly decreased after ESMR in the total group

relationships.subject: extracorporeal shockwave myocardial revascularization
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, VEGF, IL-1ß, and lipoxin A4 levels were significantly increased only in patients with myocardial ischemia improvement.

key_findings: ESMR improved angina class, ischemia, LVEF and 6-minute walk in most CAD/heart failure patients without adverse effects.
ESMR increased angiogenesis markers and decreased inflammatory markers; VEGF and lipoxin A4 rose only in patients with ischemia improvement.
